description: This is a test source file for the BasicUserRoleManager component within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing various authorization, permission, and role-based access functionalities. It contains a comprehensive test class 'BasicUserRoleManagerTest' extending KernelTestCase, with multiple test methods verifying behavior such as accessible entities, roles, permissions, home pages, and module defaults, primarily for admin, supervisor, ESS users, and other roles.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManagerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of BasicUserRoleManager's role-based access, permissions, and entity retrieval functionalities within OrangeHRM.

methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, loads data, and sets up mock environment.
